protocol_spec.name: PENCIL bridge bounded recovery queue v3

cohort.negative_rule: candidate index0 from each original1000-negative source group after full-group verification

real_semantic_audits.worker_note: Semantic audit executes sequentially in main process; declared worker setting is bound for subsequent measured loader admission.

protocol_spec.model_score_gate: Ordered complete1024-score fingerprint must match all8arms/four sweeps within each primary configuration and all4arms/four sweeps within supplemental configuration; do not pool shapes/precisions/workers/modes. Any disagreement makes logical success false.
admission: Explicit root-pinned RECOVERY_ADMISSION.json with original immutable pipeline/native/small failed PENCIL archive identities and unchanged scientific failure outcome
Root confirmed original pod absent and old StatefulSet replicas0; actual fresh replacement hostname matches receipt
No active observed native/pipeline/main/model job and no foreign original GPU/PIPELINE/ADDITIONAL timing lock
Atomic exclusive ADDITIONAL_TIMING_RUNNING.lock followed by full receipt/hostname/process/lock recheck
protocol_spec.environment: V3 preserves V2 explicit plainpath .pth after venv create and before offline pip; existing before-probe base sites only; isolated site priority retained; base numerical/native origins and pre/post snapshots exact; no base pip/sitecustomize.

budgets.guard_policy: unchanged reviewed V3 stable complete tree PSS, individual RSS lower bound, unknown-own-PSS cgroup90 safety threshold; never sum RSS as unique memory

protocol_spec.scope: Instrumented systems throughput includes S verification, per-query smaps/memory, IPC and model score copy. All native global representations remain resident; no memory saving, training, HPO, MRR, SOTA, or quality claim.

persistence.include: All whole raw outputs including verbose audit/batch fingerprints, guarded exits/logs, sampled guard logs, complete tiny/real cohort trace and protocol/source/binary hashes. No truncation or selective dropping.
persistence.exclude: Source/wheel YT objects, full graph payloads, environment trees, model checkpoints, training or quality outputs.

declared_workers_audit_note: Audit itself runs sequentially; worker field is bound for subsequent loader throughput admission.
scope: PENCIL instrumented systems throughput and exact functional equivalence only. All native representations remain resident. No training/HPO/MRR/quality claim.
